BiblicalUsage: The finger is the smallest part of the hand and the instrument of God's power: Jesus casts out devils by the finger of God, and the law itself was written by it. Thomas demands to put his finger into the print of the nails before he will believe, and the risen Lord invites him to do just that. The rich man in torment begs for one fingertip of water, and the Pharisees will not lift a finger to ease the burdens they lay on others.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the finger of God teaches us that His power is both immense and precise. He writes His law, opens deaf ears, and answers a doubter's demand with His own wounded hands.
